data.name: Edythe
data.gender_notes: Edythe is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'Edith' – 'wealth, riches' or 'wealthy' derived from 'ead' (wealth) and 'gyd' (war, battle). The name became popular in the Middle Ages as a moniker for noblewomen and queens. The name Edythe carries the meaning “Wealth or prosperity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Edythe usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth or prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes abundance and prosperity in life.
data.etymology: Edythe belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealth or prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Edythe total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אדית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אדית מקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו 'מעשיות טובות' או 'עדות אלוהית'. הוא קשור למושגים של טוב, צדק, ושמחה. השם נמצא בשימוש במסורת היהודית והנוצרית כאחד, ויש לו קונוטציות רוחניות עמוקות.

in_greek.name: Εύδοκία
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Εύδοκία προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν ἑλληνικὴ λέξη εὐδοκία, ἡ ὁποία σημαίνει 'εὐδοκία' ἢ 'εὐλογία'. Στὴν παράδοση τῆς Ἐκκλησίας ὁ ὄνομα συνδέεται μὲ τὴν ἔννοια τῆς εὐλογίας καὶ τῆς πνευματικῆς χαράς.

in_latin.name: Edythe
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Edythe derivatur ex Hebraeo et Graeco, significans 'bonam industriam' vel 'Dei testimonium'. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc habet connotationes spirituales profundas, referens ad bonitatem et justitiam.

in_english.name: Edythe
in_english.meaning: Prosperous in war, blessed, or well-doing
